title: 第25章：借力打力
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
闻言。

    马建业没有表现出高兴的情绪，最终化成一句长长的叹息。

    “小超，都怪爸没用，现在这副样子，也帮不上你什么忙。”

    “爸，你千万别这么说，你现在最重要的是养好身体，其他的有我呢。”

    第一桶金，给了马超足够的信心，他相信用不了多久，赚的钱就足够支付父亲的手术费。

    “强子。”

    “大哥，我在呢。”

    “有件事要你去做。”

    “没问题，包在我身上，大哥你要让我干什么？”

    马超笑了笑，“都不问清楚还答应的这么快，就不怕我让你做坏事。”

    马强轻哼道：“只要大哥让我做坏事，那我就做坏事好了，我相信大哥不会害我的。”

    “你倒是自信的很。”

    马超从竹筐里摸出一包水果糖出来。

    “糖，这么多糖！”

    马强直勾勾盯着，馋得不行。

    马超笑道：“想吃？”

    马强点点头，“想！哥，我的亲大哥，你就别馋我了。”
content_en:
Hear the words.

    Ma Jianye did not show any joy and eventually turned into a long sigh.

    "Xiao Chao, it's all my fault that Dad is useless. I can't help you in this way."

    "Dad, please don't say that. The most important thing for you now is to take good care of yourself. I take care of the rest."

    The first pot of gold gave Ma Chao enough confidence that he would soon earn enough to pay for his father's surgery.

    "Hadron."

    "Brother, I'm here."

    "There's something I need you to do."

    "No problem, I'll take care of it. Brother, what do you want me to do?"

    Ma Chao smiled and said, "You agreed so quickly even if you didn't even ask clearly. You are not afraid that I will let you do bad things."

    Ma Qiang hummed softly: "As long as the eldest brother lets me do bad things, then I will do bad things. I believe that the eldest brother will not harm me."

    "You are very confident."

    Ma Chao took out a pack of fruit candies from the bamboo basket.

    "Sugar, so much sugar!"

    Ma Qiang stared at it, greedy.

    Ma Chao smiled and said, "Want to eat?"

    Ma Qiang nodded, "Yes! Brother, my dear brother, please stop coveting me."
